variant.briefing:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at [Location] and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [Destination]. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry [MissionMaxSCUSize] cargo containers and bring a heavy-duty tractor beam too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
